sources.citation: Carvalho, Fernando Orphão de. 2025. On the lexical evidence for a genealogical relationship between Múra-Pirahã and Matanawi. LIAMES 25: e025005, 1-17. doi:10.20396/liames.v25i00.8677708.
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Nothing on Matanawí stress; the only 'stress placement' passage (p. 4) is about Pirahã syllable weight. States that Nimuendajú 1925 'remains, to this day, the entire corpus available for the language' (p. 8) and that Alves 2019 relied exclusively on Nimuendajú 1925 (p. 10), citing Alves 2019 pp. 41-42, 71, 75, 84.

sources.citation: Loukotka, Čestmír. 1950. La parenté des langues du bassin de la Madeira. Lingua Posnaniensis 2: 123-144.
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Nothing; Matanawí appears only in the list of isolates (p. 130): 'parlé par quelques individus seulement sur les rios Madeirinha et Castanha, état Amazonas (19, pp. 166-171)', i.e. citing Nimuendajú 1925.

sources.citation: Nimuendajú, Curt. 1925. As tribus do Alto Madeira. Journal de la Société des Américanistes 17: 137-172. Section 'V. Vocabulario Matanawí' pp. 166-171 (wordlist + short phrases from one speaker, João Comprido, Surupy, lower Marmelos, Jan./Nov. 1922); transcription key p. 148 fn. 1.
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: No prose statement. The only remark is the transcription key (p. 148 fn. 1, 'Diakritische Zeiche'): 'á tontragender Vokal' (acute = tone/stress-bearing vowel), repeated on pp. 166-168 as 'o̜, tontragender Vokal'. Stress is marked word by word in the Matanawí list; in the marked forms the acute falls predominantly on the last syllable (e.g. wisá 'terra', ayá 'pedra', apí 'agua', kayarí 'Rio Madeira', anawá 'canoa', hurá 'remo', tipití, matanawí, murá), with a few non-final marks (e.g. yátamuá 'pagé'). That distributional observation is mine, not the source's; the entire Matanawí corpus is this…

sources.citation: Valio Antunes Alves, Diego. 2019. Langue matanawí: Description phonologique et proposition de classification linguistique. MA thesis, Université de la Sorbonne, 86 pp.

sources.note: The only phonological description of the language (Glottolog listed by Glottolog as a phonology; comparative'); built on Nimuendajú 1925, it is the one place a stated stress/accent generalisation for Matanawí could exist. Would supersede the wordlist-only situation.
